integrity: Exact integer volume determinant certificate, analytic all-direction extremum proof, and supplementary numerical projected hull checks. The available published source already supplies the original brightness formula; the claimed novelty is the exact extremal/volumetric evaluation.
limitations: Limited to the Euclidean regular truncated octahedron; does not determine a full random brightness density.
Abas Eq.(53) already covers the same facet-normal brightness expression; only sharp extrema/equality and projection-body volume are claimed as new.
No independent mathematical audit; historical priority remains provisional.
title: Sharp shadow-area extrema and projection-body volume of the regular truncated octahedron
